This is a classic knight fork pattern that wins material decisively.

**Coaching Note:**
When your opponent's King and Queen are loosely coordinated, look for knight forks. A knight checking the King while attacking the Queen is devastating. Here, Nf3+ forces the King to move, then you capture the undefended Queen on the next move—winning the game.
